system.description:
[Male] only. You can equip [Medium Armor]. Increase your [Magic Defense] by + (STR Mod). 

(SR2): When you are equipped with a [Bow] in [Hand Slot], you can add a [Hafted] tag to the equipped [Bow] and it also becomes capable of [Melee Attack] with the [Range: Close].

A battle style that shoots a bow with a still mind that is unmoved by distractions, like a ray of moonlight shining through the clouds. Your steadfast defense eliminates gaps and sorrows, and the bow in your hand becomes a blade to thwart your foes.
